description: The rest of c's written [T [X] [U]] is an empty ordinary optional and then a restoration. Because [U] can read, [X] is predicted in the ordinary way and may be empty, and [U] restores U. So c is a second reading (engine §7.4).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution late-elision elision-only
%elidable T U V W
%rule text a | b | c
%rule a A [T] [U] [V]
%rule b A [T] [U] [V] [W]
%rule c A [T [X] [U]] V
